cell_line.evidence: down experiments were performed to characterize proteins interacting with TROP2 extracellular domain (TECD) using two approaches. Proteins from the pull-downs were reduced with 200 mM TCEP at 65 °C for 1 hour, alkylated with 200 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature in the dark, and digested with trypsin overnight at 37 °C. Tryptic peptides were separated from the magnetic beads, dried down, and reconstituted in 0.1% formic acid.  Tryptic peptides were analyzed using an Orbitrap Tribrid Eclipse mass spectrometer. Peptides were separated on a C18 column. MS1 scans were acquired at 240,000 resolution. MS2 scans were performed using HCD (28% CE). Dynamic exclusion was set to 30 s. Each condition was analyzed in triplicate.
